name: io.github.invoicepdfs/mcp
description: Render invoices, credit notes and quotes as PDFs, check them against EN 16931 e-invoicing rules, and reach the rest of the InvoicePDFs API on demand.

environmentVariables.name: INVOICEPDFS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An InvoicePDFs API key, created at https://invoicepdfs.com. Not scoped: it can do anything the account can.

environmentVariables.name: INVOICEPDFS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API host. Only needed when pointing at a local server.
